verdict: CAN EVERYTHING ELSE WE HAVE COMPLETE THE SPARSE PART OF THE NETWORK? Topology recovers held-out PPI edges well where the graph is already dense and not at all where it is not: in the CN=0 stratum TOPO scores 0.5000, chance, because common-neighbours and the walk are identically zero for a pair with no shared neighbours. This module adds every other layer in the dataset -- subcellular localisation, GO cellular-component, pathway and process, co-expression, DepMap co-dependency, Perturb-seq profile similarity, synthetic lethality, abundance, genomic position, and shared upstream regulators -- tiered so a gain can be attributed, and with complexes EXCLUDED outright because 92.8% of within-complex pairs are already edges and predicting an edge from co-complex membership is predicting the edge from the edge. POOLED AUC RISES, which proves nothing: TOPO 0.9579 -> +ALL-CLEAN 0.9621. Adding features to a model always does that, and 79.7% of the held-out edges live in the dense stratum where topology already worked. THE TEST IS THE CN=0 COLUMN. AND IT IS RESCUED: CLEAN-ONLY reaches 0.6314 there against topology's 0.5000, and it clears chance by more than two standard errors (0.6314 +/- 0.0328 on 82 positives). Critically CLEAN-ONLY -- the non-topology features with NO graph input at all -- scores 0.6314, and that is the arm that matters, because every topology feature is identically zero in this stratum so only a graph-free predictor can carry information here. THE CIRCULARITY CHECK is reported per source: the fraction of each source's top-decile pairs that are ALREADY recorded edges, against a base rate of 1.758%. Anything far above that is restating the graph rather than supplementing it, and the check is printed for every feature so a reader can discount them individually. WHAT THIS CANNOT SAY. The evaluation universe is knockout-knockout pairs, so nothing here speaks to the 15092 proteins without perturbation data -- and those are disproportionately the poorly-connected ones this is meant to help. 'Held-out true edge' means an edge already in a database, which is an optimistic proxy for a genuinely undiscovered one. GO evidence codes are not retained in this dataset, so interaction-derived (IPI) annotations cannot be filtered out of the GO features and the SUSPECT tier cannot be fully cleaned. One cell line, one split.
